dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: *sigh* This child... She just won't listen...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah yes, Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver have plans to go gallivanting off sometime soon, don't they? Hmm... Perhaps I'll ask them in a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: If they pass through that place, maybe they can check in on her.
